## Bilingual email triage
Gmail (or the webhook) -> classify category and priority, summarise in English, draft a reply in the sender's language (Claude, or keyword rules in dry run) -> label the email and save the draft in Gmail -> Telegram alert for urgent emails.

Dry run: POST a sample to `/webhook/email-triage?dry_run=1`. Nothing is sent and no API keys are needed.
